headline: Dragons, Pink Sand & Volcano Lakes
dek: Five encounters across Flores and Komodo
editorial_intent: Show visitors five striking real and distinctive places in Flores and Komodo, combining landscapes, volcanic colour phenomena, living cultural heritage and wild dragons.
reader_scenario: A curious traveller who knows Bali but has never considered the contrasting islands and experiences in eastern Indonesia.
share_reason: A genuine surprise-driven destination discovery: Komodo dragons, a blush-coloured coast, colour-changing volcanic crater lakes and a remote living highland village together.
slide_count_rationale: Five different documented authentic scenes with no redundant follow card; one cover and four further manually swipeable images.
caption:
Indonesia beyond Bali: where dragons roam, the sand turns pink and volcano lakes change colour. 🇮🇩

📍 Padar Island — climb to a viewpoint above sweeping curved bays.
📍 Pink Beach, Komodo — see blush-coloured sand meet turquoise water.
📍 Kelimutu, Flores — discover three crater lakes that change colour over time.
📍 Wae Rebo, Flores — trek to a highland village of distinctive cone-roofed homes.
📍 Komodo National Park — see the world's largest living lizard in its natural habitat with a guide.

Which would be your first stop?

Photos: Evan THOMAS, I CHEN LIN, yosep sare, Ash Hayes & Daniel Pelaez Duque / Unsplash.
